claims.text: Glucose screening: usually between 24 and 28 weeks; earlier (first trimester) with diabetes risk factors or prior gestational diabetes.
claims.quote: This test usually is done between 24 and 28 weeks of pregnancy. This test might be done in the first trimester of pregnancy if you have risk factors for diabetes or had gestational diabetes in a past pregnancy.

claims.text: GBS culture: done between 36 and 38 weeks, with a vaginal and rectal swab.
claims.quote: The test for GBS is called a culture. It is done between 36 and 38 weeks of pregnancy. For this test, a swab is used to take a sample from the vagina and rectum.
